description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Language_Loader' responsible for loading language files for different system sections in the Revive Adserver project. It includes logic for loading default, user-preferred, and alternative language files based on configuration and user preferences.

classes.name: Language_Loader
classes.description: A static class providing functionality to load language files based on system section and language preferences.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the appropriate language file for a given system section, considering default, user preferences, and fallback options.
